import re


def moderate_vendor_text(text):
    if not text:
        return text
    # Example moderation: remove any text containing "confidential" or "sensitive"
    moderated_text = re.sub(r".*confidential.*|.*sensitive.*", "[REDACTED]", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return moderated_text

import os
import boto3


def translate_invoice_note(text, target_language='es'):
    translate = boto3.client('translate', region_name=os.getenv('AWS_DEFAULT_REGION', 'us-west-2'))
    response = translate.translate_text(Text=text, SourceLanguageCode='en', TargetLanguageCode=target_language)
    return response.translatedText

import boto3


def store_expense_record(expense):
    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb', region_name='us-west-2')
    table = dynamodb.Table('ExpenseRecords')
    table.put_item(Item=expense)
